title: Ballerina CDC Connector
description: Production-grade Change Data Capture listener for the WSO2 Integration Platform, built on Debezium. Streams real-time database changes from MySQL, MSSQL, PostgreSQL, and OracleDB into event-driven Ballerina services.

title: DocSense
description: A RAG pipeline that answers natural language questions about Ballerina connector docs using hybrid search — dense embeddings, BM25, and RRF fusion — backed by Qdrant and Claude.

title: Claude Agents
description: A collection of custom Claude Code agents — including a Ballerina bug-fixer that diagnoses compiler and runtime errors, applies fixes, and opens pull requests automatically.

title: Ballerina Static Code Analysis Tool
description: CLI tool for static analysis of Ballerina projects, with extension points for custom rules and integration with platforms like SonarQube.

title: Ballerina Google Cloud Pub/Sub Connector
description: Publisher, subscriber, and listener implementation for Google Cloud Pub/Sub in Ballerina, enabling cloud-native event-driven architectures.

title: Personal Website
description: This site — a Next.js 15 monorepo with a tech blog and a bilingual (EN/SI) finance blog, built with Tailwind CSS and MDX.

title: RabbitMQ Order System
description: A Go-based order processing system demonstrating RabbitMQ as a message broker for decoupled, asynchronous service communication.

title: Sasnaka Sansada Backend
description: REST API for a charitable social service organization's website, covering payment gateway integration, member management, and content administration.
